headline: Aegis Logistics Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Aegis Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 89.8% stake of Tristar Holdings Limited by the Company via its 100% step-down subsidiary Aegis Logistics International Pte Ltd. (collectively Aegis)
